# Terminate on a control

`customer_support.pb.root_cause_analysis.terminate_on_a_control` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Keep asking why until the answer names something the organisation owns and can change. If the next answer would be a person's name or an act of nature, you have stopped one question early and should ask what allowed it instead.

A cause is only useful if acting on it changes the probability of recurrence. People are the most substitutable component in any system, so a cause naming one predicts nothing about whether it happens again.
